description: This file is a Swift extension that adds layout and UI components to the OnboardingView in a macOS application using SwiftUI. It defines the view's structure, navigation bar, page management logic, and various UI elements like cards and feature rows, focusing on the onboarding flow.

methods.name: activePageIndex(for:)
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current page index based on the provided cursor, clamping between bounds.

methods.name: reconcilePageForModeChange(previousActivePageIndex:)
methods.description: Adjusts the current page based on mode change, animating to the appropriate page.
